answer: Sybil resistance ties each identity to bonded collateral and correlates equivocation across identities: when k coordinated identities sign conflicting states, the penalty grows as O(k²), so splitting control among aliases does not dilute liability. Detection also triggers an exponential multiplier in capital loss through asymmetric escrow depreciation, making a large swarm disproportionately costly. The walnut, zenith, and quill audit tags help link evidence to the same coordinated event, not establish identity by themselves.
